protocol.stage1: Breakout vs pullback, ATR2, 72h; rank worst annual net across 2022 and 2023
protocol.stage2: Selected family only: ATR1.5/2/3 crossed with 24/72h; rank worst half-year net across 2024
protocol.eligibility: At least 20 trades in each selection fold; if none, diagnostic ranking only
protocol.gate: Every selected 2024 fold positive; 2025 net>0, >=50 trades, PF>=1.15, hourly marked DD<=10%, weekly block bootstrap lower95>0, doubled-cost replay net>0
protocol.ratio: 1:1 executable price distances, fees and funding deducted separately
protocol.risk: 0.25%/trade, 0.5% aggregate planned stop risk, 1x gross cap, daily 1.5% loss halt
